NAME
sys_network_ports() - display active network ports

SYNOPSIS
mixed *sys_network_ports(void);

DESCRIPTION
Returns an array of arrays, one for each network port in active use.
Added on June 1, 2023 in commit 181308d.

RETURN VALUES
For each active port, returns a subarray of this form:

       ({ (string) type, (int) port, (int) tls, })

SEE ALSO
network_stats(3)
